name: PUBH 5404
title: Environmental Health
description: Explores the policy, political and public health implications of such issues as air pollution, drinking water, exposure to hazardous chemicals, indoor air pollution, food protection, lead poisoning, housing, international issues, etc. Provides the student with some basic technical information and familiarity with terms for a better understanding of policy and political decisions and health effects of environmental exposures.
requirement_description: Open only to Master of Public Health (MPH) and Foundations of Public Health Certificate students; others with department consent.
